title: 429 traffic_rejected -> honor Retry-After
description: The traffic shaper rejects admission with 429, error_class traffic_rejected, retry_after_seconds in the body, and a matching Retry-After header. A conformant client honors Retry-After and retries after the delay. The current Mac client ignores Retry-After (divergence D2).
